mapper.insert: INSERT INTO journal_entry ( id, currency, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id, typeHandler=com.globalpay.lab.ledger.infrastructure.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{currency.currencyCode}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, currency, status, created_at FROM journal_entry WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.globalpay.lab.ledger.infrastructure.UUIDTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE journal_entry SET status = 'POSTED', posted_at = GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), created_at) WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.globalpay.lab.ledger.infrastructure.UUIDTypeHandler} AND status = 'DRAFT'
